recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The chart as a health map", "body": "Dominique Cordivari treats the birth chart as a readout of physical tendencies. Each of the twelve zodiac signs corresponds to one of the twelve inorganic mineral substances called cell salts, so Aries carries potassium phosphate, Libra sodium phosphate, Capricorn calcium phosphate and Sagittarius silica. Asked by Chance Garton where a beginner should start, she says look to the ascendant for overall vitality, the moon for anxiety and mood, and the sun as the vital force. Her recommended text is The Zodiac and the Salts of Salvation by Carey and Perry."}, {"title": "Why the ascendant is the body", "body": "Dominique describes the ascendant as the sign on the horizon at the moment of incarnation, which makes it both your automatic reaction to the world and the physical body itself. Chance Garton has Leo rising, so she points to the heart, then to Saturn and Neptune sitting in his sixth house of health routines and squaring his Libra moon. Reading from A Handbook of Medical Astrology by Jane Ridder Patrick, she links moon Saturn contacts to inhibited emotion and bladder trouble, connects his caffeine habit to Libra ruled kidneys, and recommends sodium phosphate."}, {"title": "How much of your chart is fate", "body": "The conversation keeps circling fate and free will. Dominique reads a line from Yogananda saying it is not the stars themselves that control a life but individual karma ripening under the electromagnetic vibrations of the heavenly bodies. Co-host Kaylee adds the Hellenistic idea of the natal promise, where a transit only lands if it activates something already promised in the chart. Dominique goes further, arguing that the degree to which anything activates depends on your own gnosis, your balance and, in her view, how well stocked your body is with cell salts."}, {"title": "Crystals cut to fit your aspects", "body": "Beyond the salts, Dominique matches stones to chart geometry by their molecular structure. A cubic garnet answers a square, trigonal quartz suits trines and sextiles that have gone slack, and hexagonal stones handle oppositions. She calls aura quartz a crystal antidepressant and warns that moldavite and tektite absorb dense energy and open sudden portals, so they need energetic hygiene. Chance Garton describes swapping labradorite for a synthetic piece of opalite at the third eye position on his tuning table, which changed his mind about man made stones."}, {"title": "Practical fixes you can start tonight", "body": "The episode stays usable. Dominique offers tissue salt facial analysis, reading bags under the eyes as Taurus, dark circles as Pisces and a crease as the Cancer salt, which dovetails with the facial reflexology map Chance Garton uses with his sonic slider. For anyone lactose sensitive she suggests sucrose based cell salts rather than the common lactose brands, plus custom blends. If you skip supplements entirely, get sun during a sign's season, eat the foods on the cell salt lists, work the element directly, and simply spend less of the energy you are burning through."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Dominique Cordivari of Epiastrology joins Vibe Rant to discuss the power and potential that astrology has to help one maximize their health and vitality. Likening the tendencies of personality and physiology to epigenetics, knowledge of your personal stars can help you bring free will choice to parts of your self that may have felt immutable. Supporting this discussion tonight is the great Kayleigh Berkana, a formidable astrologer in her own right!
